xychart panel type is Grafana-10.4-specific. If the deployment is downgraded below 10.0 the panel falls back to a 'Panel plugin not found' warning. Not a concern for the current 10.4.5 stack.

Metric heatmap pivots via MAX(CASE WHEN noise=...) per column. If a method has multiple runs in a single noise regime the latest run does not dominate; MAX does. For the current one-run-per-cell shape this is identical to 'latest'; if multi-run becomes a thing, swap MAX for a (SELECT value ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) subquery.
